races.paceDynamic: Royal Impact looks the most likely leader with his recent front-running win and prominent style, though Mickey The Steel, Eichan San, and several other prominent runners could press early. With limited genuine pace in this large field, the tempo should be manageable rather than fierce, setting up a tactical affair where positioning will be crucial. The heavy ground will emphasize stamina and those who handle the conditions, with the race likely to develop into a sprint from the 2f pole.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Royal Impact leads uncontested with the prominent runners settling kindly behind
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop allows hold-up horses to get into contention turning for home. God Knows and Zipster can unleash their finishing kicks from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Mickey The Steel, Eichan San and Genuine Jim engage Royal Impact for the early lead
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favors those with tactical speed who can sit handy. Merisi Diamond and Goldrush Kid can capitalize from their prominent positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Cavalry Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with Royal Impact going too slow up front
scenarios.body: A bunched field turns for home creating a cavalry charge where the best finishers prevail. Secret Magician and Rampage emerge from the pack with strong late runs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front End Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Royal Impact kicks clear approaching the 2f pole before the hold-up horses can respond
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his advantage as the heavy ground blunts the finishing kicks behind. Royal Impact holds on with Not Simple running into second despite his fading tendency.

watchPoints.text: Royal Impact's ability to dictate the pace from the front will determine how this tactical affair unfolds
Mickey The Steel and Eichan San's early positioning battle could set up the race for others behind
Zabriskie Point, Not Simple, and Red Charlie all carry fading tendencies that make them risky propositions
God Knows showed his heavy ground credentials with that recent second and comes here in good form
The large field size means positioning will be crucial with several hold-up horses needing room to maneuver
